n: UC National Center for Free Speech Detecting AI Generated Misinformation lesson
t: A 60 to 75 minute lesson on spotting AI made images, video, and misinformation.
steps: Find the lesson plan on the UC National Center for Free Speech site.
Download the PDF and the slides.
Prepare image sets for the stations.
Test TinEye, InVID, or Snopes on school devices.
Ask IT whether those sites are allowed.
